description: This file defines the Currency controller class within the OpenCart administration extension system. It manages listing, installation, and uninstallation of currency extensions, including loading related models, languages, views, and handling user permissions.

classes.name: Currency
classes.description: Controller class for managing currency extensions, providing methods for listing, installing, and uninstalling currencies in the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the default action, outputs the list of currency extensions.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and prepares the list of available and installed currency extensions, rendering the view.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Handles installing a new currency extension, including permissions, registering controllers/models, and calling the extension's install method.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Handles uninstalling a currency extension, including permissions and calling the extension's uninstall method.
